title: Normalized single tensor coefficient comparisons respect a coordinate square
statement: Use standard derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and the pinned single tensor comparison Q_a [lem-sc-picard-termwise-single-map-composition]. Let z:Z→W, q:X′→W, t:P→Z, i:J→W, r:J′→X′ and k:J′→J be scheme maps, with e:J≅Z and e′:J′≅P, and equalities e;z=i, k;e=e′;t, k;i=r;q. Let N be an O_W-module, M=T_z N, E=M[0], E′=(T_t M)[0], K=N[0], K′=(T_q N)[0], with literal tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write c for relativeMVComp [def-pc-relative-mv-maps] and C(a,b,d) for tensorPullbackCompositionIso from T_d to T_a T_b [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Set aN=C(e,z,i)⁻¹(N) and bN=C(e′,t,e′;t)⁻¹(M);C(e′;t,z,r;q)⁻¹(N);C(r,q,r;q)(N), using the displayed equalities. Suppose Q_r(T_q N) is invertible. For any alpha:L_e E→L_i K and beta:L_e′ E′→L_r K′ with alpha;Q_i(N)=Q_e(M);aN[0] and beta;Q_r(T_q N)=Q_e′(T_t M);bN[0], one has L_k(alpha);(c(k,i);transport(k;i=r;q);c(r,q)⁻¹;L_r(Q_q(N)))=c(k,e);transport(k;e=e′;t);c(e′,t)⁻¹;L_e′(Q_t(M));beta. This is solely a coefficient identity, with no direct image, base scheme or base-change mate.

proof.text: Normalize picardTermwiseSingleMap by cancelling the single images of the unique-adjoint comparison and its inverse. This is the selected homotopy counit followed by the tensor single-complex comparison. Naturality of these two transformations proves naturality in the coefficient module. Identify picardTermwiseCounit on a single with the same selected counit. Postcompose picardTermwiseSingleMap_composition with the invertible single-complex comparison and cancel its inverse; the resulting equation is c(f,g);transport;Q_a;single(C(f,g,a).hom) = L_f(Q_g);Q_f(T_g M).

Apply tensorPullbackCompositionIso_associativity to z,e.hom,k, with intermediate maps e′.hom;t and i and total map r;q, using ht,hi,heq,hsq. If x=C(k,i,r;q), y=T_k(C(e,z,i)), v=C(e′;t,z,r;q), w=C(k,e,e′;t), this says x.hom;y.hom=v.hom;w.hom. Cancelling isomorphisms gives w.hom;y.inv;x.inv=v.inv. Postcompose with C(r,q,r;q).hom. Expanding bN and cancelling C(e′,t,e′;t).hom with its inverse identifies this with the coefficient identity w.hom;T_k(aN.hom);x.inv;C(r,q,r;q).hom=C(e′,t,e′;t).hom;bN.hom. Apply the single functor.

Postcompose the desired equality with the explicitly invertible Q_r(T_q N). On the left, the composition equations for (r,q) and (k,i), the pulled-back alpha normalization, and naturality for aN rewrite the result as c(k,e);transport(ht);Q_(e′;t)(M);single(w.hom;T_k(aN.hom);x.inv;C(r,q).hom). On the right, beta normalization and the composition equation for (e′,t) cancel the inverse derived comparison and give c(k,e);transport(ht);Q_(e′;t)(M);single(C(e′,t).hom;bN.hom). The coefficient identity from step 2 equates these expressions. Cancel the final monomorphism Q_r(T_q N). The generic categorical calculation is proved explicitly in normalized_square_algebra. No Q_q or Q_t is inverted and no derived triple-composition associativity is needed.
